decision_cruda.rationale: Both radio and CMMS confirm LH-01 and LH-06 are down, with repairs not finished before 12:30 to 13:30 at best. C512-10 holds 136 t at 13.4 g/t (about 58 oz). N574-15 holds 168 t at 9.4 g/t (about 51 oz). LH-08 comes from the infrastructure heading (0.5 oz/h) to N574-15, 0.34 h away. LH-09 comes from the preparation heading (2 oz/h) to C512-10, 0.74 h away. Each stope needs about 5 h of loading by a loan. Estimated development cost is about 3 oz for LH-08 and about 11 oz for LH-09, against about 109 oz of ore gained. Stockpiles have room and the trucks are not limiting. No producing loader is taken, because those stopes' own ore would be lost.
